notes.Project: A small publishing application that exists only as a test fixture for HandOff247 (`tests/fixtures/newsroom`). Authors write articles and upload a cover image, editors review and publish them, and readers see the published articles on the front page. It is not deployed anywhere; the notes below are example text.
notes.Topic: Known issues and risks: Publishing refuses an article without a cover image while `NEWSROOM_COVER_REQUIRED` is `1` (the default). Editors usually report this as "the Publish button does nothing"; the message is shown on the review page.
notes.User: author: Reporters. They mostly ask why an article they sent is not on the front page yet: it is waiting in the editors' queue, or an editor sent it back with a note.
notes.User: editor: The news desk. They mostly ask about articles that will not publish and about cover images that do not show.
